text:
Asking rents in Dresden stand at a median of 9.53 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.2% on the year and +24.5% over five years. That ranks Dresden #32 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 38% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.92 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 572 € a month in cold rent, 13.4% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 27 days and 30% are gone within a week; with 2.7% market-active vacancy and +2.1% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.07 €/m² (+5.7%), with an 80% range of 9.80 to 10.31 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
